metadata.source: PSOC - Blackcat Ransomware activity detection via registry key modification.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Blackcat Ransomware activity detection via registry key modification
properties.description:
Detects BlackCat ransomware activity
The specific registry commands detected are used by BlackCat ransomware
properties.query:
// Service Ticket #4231548 - Sentinel - Cover Windows Registry ControlSet00x in addition to CurrentControlSet
// Detects BlackCat ransomware activity
// The specific registry commands detected are used by BlackCat ransomware
let cmd_all = dynamic(["reg","add"]);
let cmd_any = dynamic([
  "\\SYSTEM\\ControlSet001\\Services\\LanmanServer\\Parameters /v MaxMpxCt /d 65535 /t REG_DWORD /f",
  "\\SYSTEM\\ControlSet001\\Control\\Lsa /v DisableRestrictedAdmin /t REG_DWORD /d 0",
  "\\SYSTEM\\ControlSet002\\Services\\LanmanServer\\Parameters /v MaxMpxCt /d 65535 /t REG_DWORD /f",
  "\\SYSTEM\\ControlSet002\\Control\\Lsa /v DisableRestrictedAdmin /t REG_DWORD /d 0",
  "\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\LanmanServer\\Parameters /v MaxMpxCt /d 65535 /t REG_DWORD /f",
  "\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa /v DisableRestrictedAdmin /t REG_DWORD /d 0",
  "\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Explorer\\Advanced /v Hidden /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f"
]);
_Im_ProcessCreate(commandline_has_all=cmd_all,commandline_has_any=cmd_any)
| extend
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUsername", "")),
    AccountDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUserDomain", "")),
    Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("DvcHostname", "")),
    ProcessName = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessName", "")),
    ProcessId = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessId", "")),
    CommandLine = tostring(column_ifexists("CommandLine", ""))
| where isnotempty(ProcessName)
